title: Launch eve recap
lines: Jay
[confident] Keys and Neon. The launch eve recap. [pause] I'm Jay.
Rosa
[confident] And I'm Rosa. Forty years fishing the Keys, and nobody asked me.
Jay
[confident] Rosa, New Zealand is already playing. A Kiwi footballer set an alarm just to start on New Zealand time.
Rosa
[smug] In my day, we set alarms for the tide.
Jay
[confident] An HR company says time-off requests for tomorrow are up thirty-two percent worldwide.
Rosa
[smug] So the whole planet caught the same flu. [pause] Interesting.
Jay
[confident] And tonight the Miami Heat play as Vice City. Custom court and everything.
Rosa
[confident] Basketball in neon. [pause] Fine. I'll watch the fourth quarter.
Jay
[confident] Sony says the game has podcasts now. You can listen on foot, with earbuds.
Rosa
[smug] Finally, something for me. [pause] Is there a fishing show?
Jay
[confident] Not confirmed. But Rockstar showed a birdwatching logbook, with more than sixty species.
Rosa
[confident] Now you're talking. I'm going to the Keys, with binoculars. [pause] You can keep your neon.
Jay
[excited] Deal. Team Keys or Team Neon? Tell us in the comments. [pause] This was Keys and Neon, by Full Clear.
